notes: CRITICAL — COLLAPSIBLE XCONTAINERS: When a user asks for a collapsible container (aus- und einklappbar) and it is an XContainer (div), use data-cb-func=html.panel with data-cb-generateheader="true" and data-cb-autoheadertitle. An XContainer has NO legend, so data-cb-autoheadertitle is the ONLY source of the header text and MUST be NON-EMPTY: use the title from the prompt, or — when the prompt names no title — INVENT a short, meaningful title from the container's purpose/content (in the form's language). An empty/omitted data-cb-autoheadertitle renders a header with no text and is a FAIL. For XFieldSet (fieldset), use the CSS class CodBi_HTML_Panel_Standard instead — the legend provides the title automatically. By default the panel starts unfolded; only add data-cb-folded=true if the user explicitly wants the panel to start collapsed. HEADER LOOK WHEN THE PROMPT SPECIFIES NONE: a container panel has almost no base header styling (it looks spartan). When the prompt does not describe the header's look, GENERATE restrained header CSS yourself via the HTML.Panel parameters: data-cb-cssheaderfolded (base look while FOLDED — set it to the SAME CSS as data-cb-cssheaderunfolded so a folded panel looks identical), data-cb-cssheaderunfolded (base look: background, border/border-radius, padding, font-weight/color, cursor:pointer, width:100%, text-align:left), data-cb-cssheaderhover, data-cb-cssheaderactive, plus a fold indicator data-cb-cssafterheadercontent (folded, e.g. " ▾") / data-cb-cssafterheadercontentunfolded (unfolded, e.g. " ▴"). EVERY such value is a RAW CSS DECLARATION LIST WITHOUT braces and WITHOUT a selector (e.g. "background:#eef2f7; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:6px;"), NEVER a { } object; the ...content parameters hold a PLAIN STRING. If the prompt describes the look, follow it exactly. MANDATORY — NEVER SKIP A CONTAINER PANEL'S HEADER STYLING (even when the request does not mention styling): creating/converting an XContainer into a collapsible panel (data-cb-func=html.panel) REQUIRES (a) HTML.Panel in the need_codbi_details request, (b) data-cb-generateheader="true" + a non-empty data-cb-autoheadertitle, (c) the header CSS ON THE PANEL ITSELF via the html.panel parameters (data-cb-cssheaderfolded = data-cb-cssheaderunfolded, plus data-cb-cssheaderhover, data-cb-cssheaderactive, data-cb-cssafterheadercontent[unfolded]), and (d) HTML.Panel listed in the _codbiApplicability applied array. NEVER return codbiVerdict='none' with empty considered/applied for such a request. The same applies when the form ALREADY has container panels without header styling — set the header CSS parameters and report HTML.Panel as considered/applied.

classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Standard: Apply to a fieldset to wrap it in a collapsible panel with shaded header that changes color when unfolded. Use on XFieldSet only (containers must use data-cb-func=html.panel with data-cb-autoheadertitle). Apply to EVERY XFieldSet that shall be a collapsible panel — a standalone panel AND every accordion member; NEVER to the accordion's wrapping container.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Flat: Apply to a fieldset to wrap it in a flat (no shading) collapsible panel. Use on XFieldSet only.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Minimal: Apply to a fieldset to wrap it in a minimal collapsible panel. Use on XFieldSet only.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Index: Apply to a fieldset to add an index/anchor navigation panel. Use on XFieldSet only.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_NoCordion: Apply to a container inside an accordion group to exclude it from accordion behavior.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_A: Apply to a container to set up accordion group A. The container is NOT a panel — do NOT give it a panel type class (CodBi_HTML_Panel_Standard/Flat/Index/Minimal). Every member XFieldSet inside must ALSO carry a panel type class to become collapsible. Panels with the same accordion letter will fold/unfold together.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_B: Apply to a container to set up accordion group B. The container is NOT a panel — do NOT give it a panel type class; every member XFieldSet inside must ALSO carry one.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_C: Apply to a container to set up accordion group C. The container is NOT a panel — do NOT give it a panel type class; every member XFieldSet inside must ALSO carry one.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_D: Apply to a container to set up accordion group D. The container is NOT a panel — do NOT give it a panel type class; every member XFieldSet inside must ALSO carry one.
